name: momentum_score_composite_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when five independent momentum signals — 2-minute RSI velocity, MACD histogram acceleration, 1-minute rate-of-change, ADX directional bias, and volume-price direction — simultaneously align in the same direction, it indicates that multiple algorithmic strategy families (momentum-chasers, trend-followers, volume-participation systems) are all positioned in the same direction at the same time. This simultaneous agreement at the 1-3 minute timescale on NIFTY signals that institutional order flow has reached critical mass: the underlying directional program trades still have unfilled volume that will continue to absorb liquidity for the next 30-90 seconds. A composite score > 55 (out of 100 max) with 15-second persistence filters out the cases where only one or two indicators spike.
core_signal_oneliner: Weighted composite of five momentum sub-signals (RSI, MACD, ROC, ADX, volume-direction) exceeding a threshold for 15 consecutive seconds, indicating multi-algorithm directional confluence
